## MASTER-ARCH-001

Adds the canonical System Completeness & Authority Contract to `ARCHITECTURE.md`.

### Included
- global authority boundaries
- state/data ownership model
- identity and trust chain
- decentralized network/P2P contract
- memory federation contract
- canonical API/interface contract
- event contract
- security boundaries
- failure/recovery lifecycle
- upgrade/migration lifecycle
- compatibility contract
- observability/evidence contract
- deployment/topology contract
- Aurora / Genesis / GlobusOS / ShivaCore domain boundaries
- repository/SSOT separation
- architecture completeness and repository mapping gates
- explicit Architecture ≠ Implementation ≠ Test ≠ CI ≠ E2E boundary

This PR changes architecture documentation only; it does not claim implementation of the defined contracts.
